narration.en: Our data comes from interactive portals like ASAP and GSCM, where we download ready-made reports.
narration.spoken: Our data comes from interactive portals like A S A P and G S C M, where we download ready-made reports.

narration.en: But downloads alone aren't ready for analysis or scheduled reporting. We still need to extract the data, standardize its format, and load it into a destination.
narration.spoken: But downloads alone aren't ready for analysis or scheduled reporting. We still need to extract the data, standardize its format, and load it into a destination.

narration.en: Meet Metronome. Build data pipelines in minutes, without code. Schedule them, trigger a run when you need it, and track every run in one place.
narration.spoken: Meet Metronome. Build data pipelines in minutes, without code. Schedule them, trigger a run when you need it, and track every run in one place.

narration.en: Instead of writing a script, build your own Flow. Choose a website and the report you need.
narration.spoken: Instead of writing a script, build your own Flow. Choose a website and the report you need.

narration.en: Choose where the data goes and when it runs.
narration.spoken: Choose where the data goes and when it runs.

narration.en: While the script is still being written, your Flow is ready. No code needed.
narration.spoken: While the script is still being written, your Flow is ready. No code needed.

narration.en: At two AM, local AI agents keep working across your reports and pipelines, checking missing data, refresh issues, and blank rows.
narration.spoken: At two a.m., local AI agents keep working across your reports and pipelines, checking missing data, refresh issues, and blank rows.

narration.en: By morning, five issues are flagged. Open one to see the evidence and a proposed fix.
narration.spoken: By morning, five issues are flagged. Open one to see the evidence and a proposed fix.

narration.en: There are two ways to use Metronome. Open it in your browser, just like any other website.
narration.spoken: There are two ways to use Metronome. Open it in your browser, just like any other website.

narration.en: Or connect Metronome MCP to your AI, and create flows with a prompt.
narration.spoken: Or connect Metronome M C P to your AI, and create flows with a prompt.

narration.en: Without that connection, your AI may take wrong turns, retry steps, or return the wrong reporting period.

narration.en: With Metronome MCP, it can follow the portal workflow, create your Flow, and check the result.
